summary: Sync Purchase Order Contract Line Items
description:
Sync Purchase Order Contract Line Items.
Note: A budget line item will automatically be created for Non-budgeted line items for all new projects and for projects enabled with Non-Budgeted line item beta functionality

entities.description: Line Items successfully created or updated by the sync operation.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Line Item.

amount.description: Bottom-line amount for this Line Item, as a decimal string in the contract's currency.

company.description: Company that owns the project this Line Item belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this Line Item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

description.description: Free-text description of the work or cost this Line Item covers.

extended_type.description: Indicates whether the Line Item amount is entered manually or derived from quantity multiplied by unit cost.

holder.description: The parent record (e.g. a contract) that owns this Line Item.

origin_data.description: Free-form data from a third-party or ERP system associated with this Line Item. Null when the Line Item did not originate from an external system.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this Line Item in the third-party or ERP system it originated from. Null when there is no external origin.

position.description: Ordering position of this Line Item within the contract.

project.description: Project this Line Item belongs to.

quantity.description: Quantity for this Line Item, as a decimal string.

tax_code_id.description: ID of the tax code applied to this Line Item.

total_amount.description: Total amount for this Line Item before markup, as a decimal string in the contract's currency.

extended_amount.description: The line item's bottom-line amount as a decimal string in the contract's currency. Equals the manually entered amount when `extended_type` is `manual`, or quantity multiplied by unit cost when `ext...

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit for this Line Item, as a decimal string.

uom.description: Unit of measure label for the quantity, drawn from the company's Units of Measure list.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this Line Item was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

errors.description: Line Items that could not be created or updated, each paired with the validation errors that prevented the change.

amount.description: Line item total amount as a decimal string in the contract currency.

cost_code_id.description: ID of the cost code assigned to this line item.

description.description: Free-text description of the line item.

extended_type.description: Whether the line item amount is entered manually or calculated from quantity and unit cost.

quantity.description: Line item quantity as a decimal string; combined with unit_cost to derive the amount.

line_item_type_id.description: ID of the line item type (e.g. Materials, Equipment) classifying this line item.

origin_data.description: External source data used to reconcile this line item with an integrating system.

origin_id.description: External source identifier used to reconcile this line item with an integrating system.

tax_code_id.description: ID of the tax code applied to this line item.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit as a decimal string; combined with quantity to derive the amount.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the line item. Accepts any value present in the Company's list of Units of Measure.

wbs_code_id.description: ID of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code assigned to this line item.
